articles.title: Oppo launches Find X10 Pro Max, Find X10, Pad Mini and Enco X4 in India
articles.description: With the Find X10 series, Oppo has officially rolled out its new operating skin, ColorOS 17, based on Android 17 in India. Gradually, it will arrive in other Oppo devices

articles.title: SBI’s cyber defences: What the bank had in place
articles.description: The bank’s FY26 reports detail IT audits, automated threat monitoring and security testing, and outline plans for an integrated Cyber Defence Centre

articles.title: Oil hits near six-month high as Houthi attacks rattle Saudi Arabia
articles.description: Brent crude futures (December) were trading about 3.2% higher than their previous close at $112.35 per barrel on Thursday afternoon

articles.title: Machine mayhem: How sentient AI could put businesses in a quandary
articles.description: The day a machine appears to care if we switch it off, CEOs will discover a problem no policy can address yet. We'd be fooled if we believed a bot was conscious when it wasn't, and could create a new class of exploited beings if we assume a bot isn’t conscious when it is. Both attract legal hassles.

articles.title: Bat Appreciation Week | Green Humour by Rohan Chakravarty
AI hype and dotcom déjà vu: Sorry to burst your bubble, but this doesn't look like one
articles.description: America's AI-dominated bull market has many drawing nervous comparisons to the dotcom bubble. But there's reason to doubt the doom. The animal spirits that usually propel bubbles are in short supply.

articles.title: Global slump: Why corporate capex in India is unlikely to rise just yet
articles.description: Capital expenditure by corporate firms has been weak in much of the world. But India's total investment-to-GDP ratio has been better than pre-covid and is second only to China. That said, global policy flux and unfavourable government capex weigh against strong pick-up.&nbsp;

articles.title: Why the UPI MDR debate is about more than finding an acceptable transaction fee
articles.description: The debate around merchant discount rates (MDR) on the Unified Payment Interface (UPI) has raised the question of how the system can be made sustainable so all participants have the incentive to use it. India needs to think on this carefully as markets built around digital infrastructure expand.

articles.title: India is within its rights to use duties others have weaponized against the Global South
articles.description: A study has shown a fall in the implementation of anti-dumping duties recommended by the Directorate General of Trade Remedies. This, even as large economies have weaponized trade remedies to degrade the industrial base of the Global South. What is fair for them should be fair for us too.

articles.title: Current El Nino event could be unprecedented in strength: WMO
articles.description: It stated that sea surface temperatures in the tropical Pacific may rise to 3.8 degrees Celsius above average during November 2026 to January 2027

articles.title: After Musk ‘punishes’ Ukraine, how exposed is India to foreign tech?
articles.description: Elon Musk’s reported restrictions on satellite services to Ukraine show the risks of India’s dependence on foreign-controlled technology; from satellite navigation to cloud computing and military equipment, gaps in domestic capabilities can leave critical infrastructure exposed to external pressure

articles.title: eBay to slash 1,000 more jobs, around 9% of workforce
articles.description: eBay had 12,300 employees at the end of 2025, before announcing a first round of layoffs in February

articles.title: France’s debt crisis explained: Could it trigger another euro zone meltdown?
articles.description: France’s debt crisis explained: Economic activity has contracted, and rising borrowing risks are adding to concerns about France’s finances. With protests weighing on business confidence, tourism prospects and public finances, there are fears of meltdown across Euro zone.

articles.title: 500 GW by 2030: Experts explain why India needs to power up battery storage capacity and grid infra to meet the target
articles.description: India needs to expand battery storage and modernise its power grid to achieve its 500 GW non-fossil fuel capacity target by 2030, experts said. India had installed 300.50 GW of non-fossil fuel capacity as of July 31, 2026.

articles.title: India’s commerce and industry ministry working to identify AI proof sectors: Piyush Goyal
articles.description: India is working to identify sectors that can withstand AI-led disruption, commerce minister Piyush Goyal said.

articles.title: Rishikesh–Karnaprayag rail line to have 16 tunnels: How India’s homegrown technology is advancing Himalayan connectivity
articles.description: India is expanding its domestic tunnel boring machine (TBM) manufacturing capabilities as construction advances on the 125-km Rishikesh–Karnaprayag railway line.&nbsp;

articles.title: India’s private sector activity hits four-month high as inflation cools: HSBC Flash India PMI
articles.description: India’s private sector activity hit a four-month high in October as manufacturing and services gathered pace, new orders increased and inflationary pressures eased. However, hiring growth slowed, with employment rising at its weakest pace so far this year, according to a flash survey by HSBC.

articles.title: Taxing top 1% isn't enough to solve income inequality; how governments spend matters | Opinion
articles.description: 'Justice is the first virtue of social institutions…laws and institutions no matter how efficient and well-arranged must be reformed or abolished if they are unjust...an injustice is tolerable only when it is necessary to avoid an even greater injustice.'

articles.title: India's Mideast oil imports return to pre-war levels in September
articles.description: Refiners snapped up spot cargoes as Middle Eastern producers and traders cranked up shipments through the Strait of Hormuz, easing supply constraints caused by the Iran war.

articles.title: The story of India’s post-election defection wave since 2022, in charts
articles.description: Between 2022 and 2026, over 100 Indian lawmakers at the central and state levels switched parties, largely leveraging legal loopholes in the anti-defection law. The NDA has been the primary beneficiary.

articles.title: RBI MPC Minutes: Governor Sanjay Malhotra ties future hikes to growth-inflation outlook — here is what he said
articles.description: MPC meeting minutes: The differing views of policymakers highlighted the challenge facing the RBI as it attempts to contain inflation without unnecessarily restricting economic activity.

articles.title: RBI MPC minutes reveal 2 members opposed shift from neutral stance to calibrated tightening in October meeting
articles.description: The RBI raised its repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50%, with all six monetary policy committee members supporting the hike. Four backed a shift to calibrated tightening, while two of them preferred a neutral stance. Details here.

articles.title: Core sector growth accelerates to 7.9% in September, fastest in new series
articles.description: Iron ore output grew 18.4% in September, followed by electricity at 11.4%, coal at 10.7%, refinery products at 10.3%, cement at 9.8% and steel at 4.9%. Fertilizers, natural gas and crude oil registered contractions of 11.7%, 4.6% and 1.4%, respectively.

articles.title: India's infrastructure output grows 7.9% year-on-year in September on strong coal, steel output
articles.description: The growth was also higher than the 3.1% increase seen in September last year. Higher output of coal, refinery products, steel and iron ore helped drive the growth, according to the data.

articles.title: IMF urges currency flexibility as RBI steps up rupee defence amid oil price pressures, foreign outflows
articles.description: Foreign-exchange intervention offers limited benefits beyond the near term and currencies should be allowed to adjust to global shocks, a top International Monetary Fund official said.

articles.title: Govt to overhaul tax refund schemes for exporters, sets up two panels
articles.description: The move follows a recommendation by the expenditure finance committee late last month for better targeting and optimal use of funds

articles.title: The changing template of global growth—and what it means for India
articles.description: The world economy may have remained resilient in 2026, but volatility and unpredictability are far from over, and their impact could weigh on India’s growth trajectory as well.&nbsp;

articles.title: India-New Zealand trade pact takes effect on October 20: How it benefits both sides | Key highlights
articles.description: India’s free trade agreement with New Zealand takes effect on October 20, offering Indian exports full duty-free access and targeting bilateral trade of about ₹35,000 crore by 2030. Key highlights of the pact here.

articles.title: Amitabh Kant on how India’s semiconductor future is taking shape: 6 states with 12 projects,  ₹1.64 lakh cr investments
articles.description: Gujarat emerges as the largest semiconductor hub, with six approved projects, including Tata-PSMC’s ₹91,526 crore fabrication plant.

articles.title: India-New Zealand FTA: No tariff on Indian exports from Oct 20; Textile, pharma, leather exports to gain market access
articles.description: The India-New Zealand FTA takes effect on 20 October, eliminating tariffs on all Indian exports to New Zealand. The move is expected to boost sectors including textiles, leather, pharmaceuticals and agriculture, improve exporters’ competitiveness and deepen bilateral trade ties.

articles.title: Is India’s solar power play facing its Icarus moment?
articles.description: India’s electricity grid is struggling to keep up with its solar power boom. Can the government fix the infrastructure bottlenecks before they derail the country’s clean energy ambitions?

articles.title: FM Sitharaman flags global capital moving towards US, AI-linked markets as a ‘concern’ for India in 2027
articles.description: FM Nirmala Sitharaman warned that continued capital outflows and global investment shifting toward the US and AI markets pose major risks to India in 2027. Details here.

articles.title: Govt plans  ₹25,000-crore skilling push to sharpen textile export edge
articles.description: The Samarth 2.0, announced in the budget for 2026–27, aims to modernise the existing skilling framework through closer collaboration between industry and academic institutions, with a focus on preparing workers for the changing technology and industry requirements.

articles.title: India vs China in 40 years: TRUST MF CIO Mihir Vora - 'India compounded GDP growth at 7.3%; China broke out at 11.3%'
articles.description: TRUST Mutual Fund CIO Mihir Vora said India's GDP expanded 15.7-fold in 40 years, compared with China's 65.1-fold growth. He attributed the divergence to a gap in annualised growth rates and urged India to address obstacles to ease of doing business.

articles.title: India's exports to West Asia recover from US-Iran war shock in April-August; shipments to Africa, ASEAN rise
articles.description: India’s exports to West Asia are recovering from conflict-related disruption, while shipments to Africa, ASEAN and North-East Asia grew strongly in April-August. Details here.

articles.description: A look at the key economic developments, data releases and market events that could shape the week ahead.

articles.title: The week in charts: Jio’s mega debut, deferred UPI charges, IDBI bank stake sale
articles.description: In this weekly Plain Facts compilation, we present to you data-based insights, with easy-to-read charts, to help you delve deeper into the stories reported by Mint in the week gone by.

articles.title: 800 million jobs at risk over 15 years? World Bank's Ajay Banga calls for global financing overhaul
articles.description: World Bank President Ajay Banga said 1.2 billion young people would enter the global workforce over the next 10 to 15 years, against an estimated 400 million jobs. The institution also plans to raise critical minerals financing to $19 billion over fiscal 2026-2030 and mobilise more private capital.

articles.title: PM-SETU: Five ITI clusters to get  ₹1,195 crore investment from Tata Steel Foundation, BVG India, others
articles.description: Tata Steel Foundation, BVG India, Belrise Industries, Eagle Infra India and Inderdeep Infra India will partner in upgrading the five ITI clusters. The cumulative investment approved under the PM-SETU scheme till now is to the tune of ₹3,687 crore, news agency PTI agency said.

articles.title: Vibrant Goa summit to connect 220 Goan MSMEs with 300+ global buyers – What to expect?
articles.description: The three-day event will take place from 29 October to 31 October at the Dr Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Indoor Stadium, Goa University, Taleigao, and is expected to bring together business leaders from 50+ countries, the Government of Goa said in a statement.

articles.title: ‘Most consequential change’: Kevin Warsh says AI will reshape US economy, warns of a ‘bumpy’ road ahead
articles.description: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh called AI a major force in the global economy, saying it could raise inflation in the short term through investment while boosting productivity over time. He warned that uncertainty about the technology and emerging markets could make the transition bumpy.

articles.title: India may hike fuel prices in November, pushing inflation above RBI target: Oxford Economist
articles.description: India may raise fuel prices moderately in November, a brief window to do so before crucial state elections early next year, Oxford Economics said.
